race.description: Eric & Vall Nobbs Thangool Cup Qtis Hcp (C3)
race.comment: THE DEFENDER (4) made it two wins on the bounce last start when he scored by 1.4 lengths over 1200m at Mackay. Finds a suitable race and can figure in the finish. BITTER SPIRIT (2) was safely held last start when ninth over 1600m at Doomben. May appreciate the shorter journey this time. This is far easier. Leading contender. HOU LONG GWAI (3) finished out of the money two starts back then he was always well out of his ground and was beaten 3.5 lengths when fifth over 1560m at Mackay three-and-a-half weeks ago. Suitably placed so anticipating a big run this time. THREE GONGS (5) was below his best last time, finishing tenth and beaten 45 lengths over 1608m at Gladstone. Likely improver with top-three prospects.
